definitions.sourceRecordSha256: SHA-256 of the complete record.sourceRecord object serialized as compact JSON preserving its captured property order and Unicode, UTF-8 without an added newline; independently recomputed equal to sourceRecordHash in the pinned snapshot. Unlike searchDocumentSha256 this serialization is not key-sorted.
definitions.renderedTextSha256: SHA-256 of record.rendering.innerText encoded as UTF-8, without an added newline.
definitions.searchDocumentSha256: SHA-256 of the entire record.publicSearch object serialized as recursive key-sorted compact JSON, Unicode preserved (Python json.dumps(object,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False)), UTF-8, without an added newline. It is not the digest of searchText alone.
definitions.searchTextUtf8Sha256: Separately reported SHA-256 of record.publicSearch.searchText UTF-8 bytes, without an added newline.

result: All recorded object, rendered text and whole search-document hashes reconcile exactly. Source classifications and findings are unchanged; this additive receipt makes the serialization scope explicit.
